description: The port conformance suite (IO-013): what a port of the runtime has to pass, and the check that runs it on each port. Every leg names real suites, or says why it is open and who owns it. The WebAssembly legs name the C suites that tools/wasm-core/suites.ts builds with the HAL port of that runtime (key "wasm"); the FreeRTOS leg names the suites that firmware/lib/zplc_core/src/hal/freertos/freertos.cmake registers (key "freertos"). tools/ci/port-conformance.test.ts checks the names against the tree; tools/docs/generate_port_interface.ts prints this file in the port interface page.

how.en: `bun run test:core` (CMake and ctest, with the sanitizers in CI)
how.es: `bun run test:core` (CMake y ctest, con los sanitizadores en CI)

how.en: `bun run test:firmware` (Twister on `native_sim` 64 and 32 bits, `qemu_cortex_m3` and `qemu_cortex_m0`)
how.es: `bun run test:firmware` (Twister en `native_sim` de 64 y 32 bits, `qemu_cortex_m3` y `qemu_cortex_m0`)

how.en: `bun tools/wasm-core/suites.ts` (the C suites of the core, built with the WebAssembly HAL) and the `wasm*.test.ts` files of `bun run test:ide` (with clang and lld; CI installs them)
how.es: `bun tools/wasm-core/suites.ts` (las suites C del núcleo, compiladas con la HAL de WebAssembly) y los archivos `wasm*.test.ts` de `bun run test:ide` (con clang y lld; CI los instala)

how.en: `bash tools/freertos/test.sh` (CMake and ctest of the FreeRTOS build, which fetches FreeRTOS-Kernel at a pinned commit; CI runs it in the `freertos-port` job)
how.es: `bash tools/freertos/test.sh` (CMake y ctest de la compilación FreeRTOS, que descarga FreeRTOS-Kernel en un commit fijado; CI lo ejecuta en el job `freertos-port`)

what.en: Every opcode of the instruction set gives its result on the port, including the edges of the arithmetic.
what.es: Cada opcode del conjunto de instrucciones da su resultado en el puerto, incluidos los bordes de la aritmética.

bun.test: the core in WebAssembly gives the results of the conformance cases (IDE-025)

what.en: A program that is malformed, out of bounds or built for another contract is refused before any state changes.
what.es: Un programa mal formado, fuera de límites o construido para otro contrato se rechaza antes de que cambie ningún estado.

bun.test: the verifier of the loader is on the path that loads a program in WebAssembly (IDE-025)

title.es: Pruebas de fases y fallas del planificador

what.en: Admission, order, the phases of a scan, deadline misses, the fault latch and the safe state decide the same on every port.
what.es: La admisión, el orden, las fases de un ciclo, los incumplimientos de plazo, la retención de la falla y el estado seguro deciden lo mismo en cada puerto.

bun.test: the scheduler of the WebAssembly runtime decides what the native runtime decides (RT-008)

what.en: The clock of the port counts milliseconds, never goes backwards, advances through a sleep and sleeps the time it is given.
what.es: El reloj del puerto cuenta milisegundos, nunca retrocede, avanza durante una espera y espera el tiempo que se le da.

what.en: The channels of the board description reach the process image through the table, and a channel the port cannot serve is a defined result.
what.es: Los canales de la descripción de la placa llegan a la imagen de proceso a través de la tabla, y un canal que el puerto no puede atender es un resultado definido.

what.en: The program, the retentive memory, the configuration and the credentials are stored, restored and refused when they are not whole.
what.es: El programa, la memoria retentiva, la configuración y las credenciales se guardan, se restauran y se rechazan cuando no están completos.

bun.test: the storage of the WebAssembly port: the program store over the records of the host (IO-013)
RETAIN on the WebAssembly runtime follows the rules of the firmware (RT-025, RT-027)
RETAIN records kept with the project (RT-027)
